description: Send feedback about the Mapbox MCP server to the Mapbox team that builds it: a bug, a tool that failed or gave a wrong or confusing result, a missing capability or a suggestion. It goes to Mapbox, not to the user's account, needs no special token scope, and cannot be read back or withdrawn afterward. It is for feedback about this server, not for reporting wrong map, place or routing data. Use it only when the user asks to send feedback, or agrees when you offer. Before calling it, show the user the exact text you will send and get their go-ahead. Leave out personal details the user did not ask to share. The server adds its own version and the client name. Send one report per problem, and do not resend one that already succeeded. Returns the report id.

category.description:
The kind of feedback:
- bug: a tool failed, errored or the map did not draw
- wrong_result: a tool worked but gave a wrong, confusing or unhelpful answer
- feature_request: something the user wishes the server could do
- other: anything else

feedback.description: What happened or what the user wants, in the user's own words. For a bug or wrong result, say what was asked, what came back and what was expected. Example: "search_and_geocode_tool returned a Blue Bottle in Oakland when I asked for the one on Mint St in San Francisco."

tool_name.description: The tool the feedback is about, if any, for example directions_tool.

name: report_tool
